purpose: Resolve a comparable collection of records into a searchable, filterable, selectable workspace with contextual detail.

shell.selectionRule: Use AppShell when persistent workspace navigation and operational density are part of the task.

conditional.Sidebar: required when the consumer has persistent workspace navigation; omit for an embedded list surface.
conditional.KPICluster: include when a small set of decision metrics frames the collection before scanning rows.
conditional.FilterToolbar: include when search plus one or more filters, sort, or result actions are required.
conditional.Pagination: include when the collection is server-paged or exceeds the visible row budget.
conditional.BulkActionBar: include when selection enables one or more actions across records.
conditional.DetailDrawer: include when a record can be inspected without losing list context.

forbid: unbounded card gallery for comparable records

rationale.AppShell: The reference intent is a persistent operational workspace, not a standalone marketing route.
rationale.PageHeader: The collection needs an accountable title, context, and route-level actions.
rationale.DataTable: Rows must remain comparable across stable columns and support semantic sort and selection.
rationale.FilterToolbar: Query controls stay adjacent to the collection so the result context remains visible.
rationale.DetailDrawer: Quick inspection preserves list position and avoids forcing every record into a new route.
